purpose: Bound V1 release accounting without expanding the aggregation lock. The aggregation lock pins reproducible aggregate members; it is not the complete public V1 product matrix.

aggregation_lock.scope: Exact commits, package versions, selected contract artifacts, and lockstep attestations for the aggregate member set.
non_scope: The full public V1 product matrix.
A green full Python-reference parity result.

The current Python nirs4all repository, selected from the nirs4all-python RC worktree and targeted for a future nirs4all-python repo rename, remains the V1 Python reference but is not an aggregation-lock member.

aggregation_lock_members.release_role: DAG runtime and native execution contracts
Data provider contracts and DMD representations

Portable aggregate bindings, selected from RC-v1-nirs4all-core. repo_path stays nirs4all-lite until the GitHub repo rename; nirs4all-core is an explicit public alias.

relation_types.locked_member: The public surface is itself represented by an aggregation-lock member.
relation_types.covered_by_locked_member: The public surface is emitted by, or package-declared under, an aggregation-lock member, but it is not an additional lock member.
relation_types.outside_aggregation_lock: The public surface is part of V1 release accounting but is not pinned by the aggregation lock.

public_v1_surfaces.proof_boundary: Tier-1 behavioral oracle and compatibility API; full pyref parity remains a separate gate, not implied by the aggregation lock.
public_v1_surfaces.local_gate_policy: pyref_oracle_full passed on selected RC heads in Wave 4H; rerun on any later final selected heads.

public_v1_surfaces.proof_boundary: Python aggregate target distribution is covered by the selected RC-v1-nirs4all-core member; the historical nirs4all oracle remains a separate outside-lock surface.
public_v1_surfaces.local_gate_policy: lite/core Python topology tests plus pyref_oracle_full on final selected heads.

public_v1_surfaces.proof_boundary: Package topology is covered by the locked lite member; local R execution may still be skipped if R is unavailable and must be reported as risk.
public_v1_surfaces.local_gate_policy: test-r-if-available; missing R is not a green release proof.

public_v1_surfaces.proof_boundary: Package topology is covered by the locked lite member; browser/runtime parity and product e2e remain separate gates.
public_v1_surfaces.local_gate_policy: test-wasm and browser smoke where the touched surface requires it.

public_v1_surfaces.proof_boundary: Scoped package declaration is covered by the locked methods member; methods/native binding parity remains a methods gate.
public_v1_surfaces.local_gate_policy: methods WASM build/smoke plus methods parity evidence when the exposed capability changes.

public_v1_surfaces.proof_boundary: Scoped package declaration is covered by the locked optional/external datasets member; catalog checksums remain the release gate.
public_v1_surfaces.local_gate_policy: datasets_catalog_checksums plus browser/WASM smoke when the package surface changes.

public_v1_surfaces.proof_boundary: Rust aggregate crate is covered by the selected RC-v1-nirs4all-core member; crate publication/fetchability remains a separate release gate.
public_v1_surfaces.local_gate_policy: lite/core Rust package tests and release topology checks on selected heads.

public_v1_surfaces.proof_boundary: MATLAB/Octave namespace archive is covered by the selected RC-v1-nirs4all-core member; local execution remains subset evidence until release infrastructure runs it.
public_v1_surfaces.local_gate_policy: lite/core MATLAB/Octave package topology checks where the environment is available.

public_v1_surfaces.proof_boundary: Public product release surface; not a member of the aggregation lock. Playwright/runtime e2e remains an environment gate.
public_v1_surfaces.local_gate_policy: npm run lint:parallel, npm run test:parallel, and Playwright/screenshot gates when product UI/runtime surfaces change.

public_v1_surfaces.display_name: nirs4all-ui shared React component and view-model package
public_v1_surfaces.proof_boundary: Shared React UI components and pure TypeScript view-model helpers for Studio/Web consumers; not a member of the aggregation lock and not a backend, parser, persistence, ML, or parity-proof surface.
public_v1_surfaces.local_gate_policy: npm run typecheck, npm test, npm run build, plus component/visual baseline checks when React UI surfaces change.

public_v1_surfaces.proof_boundary: Public client-side-only browser/WASM product surface; not a member of the aggregation lock, implies no Python server, and must not overclaim Python parity.
public_v1_surfaces.local_gate_policy: typecheck/build/Vitest/client-side browser smoke according to touched Web surface.

public_v1_surfaces.proof_boundary: Published Python provider client surface; the canonical release contract remains the neutral schemas in docs/contracts/providers and must stay consumable by R/WASM/native clients without a Python dependency.
public_v1_surfaces.local_gate_policy: providers_local_sibling_release plus canonical schema byte-identity and fixture validation in the providers repo.

public_v1_surfaces.proof_boundary: Published operational cockpit/site surface; outside the aggregation lock and separate from the client-side nirs4all-web product.
public_v1_surfaces.local_gate_policy: site build/deploy smoke according to the touched cockpit publication surface.

public_v1_surfaces.proof_boundary: Published public site surface; outside the aggregation lock and distinct from the aggregate runtime/package topology.
public_v1_surfaces.local_gate_policy: static-site validation/build smoke when org publication content or release claims change.

public_v1_surfaces.proof_boundary: Public support/migration surface; not a runtime dependency of the aggregation lock.
public_v1_surfaces.local_gate_policy: legacy migration converter fixtures, dry-run/verify-only, and golden preservation tests.

public_v1_surfaces.proof_boundary: Public/distribution candidate for cluster execution; not an aggregation-lock member and not a substitute for runtime parity.
public_v1_surfaces.local_gate_policy: targeted RBAC/client/core-adapter tests plus e2e when the cluster release claim changes.
